concerns: In DialogService.handleStopTrigger, throwing generic IllegalArgumentException instead of a custom domain exception when Dialog is not found.

In DialogService.receiveInboundMessage, the saved message is not added back to the Dialog's message list in memory, which might cause inconsistency if the Dialog object is reused within the same session before a reload.
In /api/v1/conversations/{conversationId}/messages GET endpoint, the 401 and 500 responses do not reference the ErrorResponse schema, unlike other endpoints.
In WebSocketEvent schema, the 'oneOf' composition for the payload is defined without a 'discriminator', which may make polymorphism harder to deserialize in strongly typed target languages.
The UI currently uses mock hardcoded chat and message data in `App.svelte` instead of fetching from real backend API endpoints.
The layout imports Google Fonts and Material Symbols directly via HTML `link` tags; using a local or bundled asset approach would be more robust for self-hosted networks.
